title: What Can You Do in Madeira If You Do Not Want to Hike?
description: Plenty: see the cliffs from a boat, ride the cable car to Monte, walk the gardens, taste Madeira wine and drive to viewpoints a few steps from the car park.
heroAlt: Patterned flower beds in the Madeira Botanical Garden above the red roofs and bay of Funchal
keywords: what to do in madeira if you do not hike
easy things to do in madeira

images.prompt: Late morning in the Madeira Botanical Garden on the slope above Funchal. In the foreground, geometric flower beds in red, yellow and dark green laid out like a patterned carpet on a terrace, with a few palm trees and succulents. Far below, the red roofs of Funchal and the blue bay with the harbour. An older couple seen small from behind sits on a bench at the edge of the terrace, looking at the view. Clear light, true colours, no faces, no text.
images.alt: Patterned flower beds in the Madeira Botanical Garden above the red roofs and bay of Funchal

images.prompt: A Funchal cable car cabin seen from slightly below and behind, rising over the green slopes and white houses above the old town, the blue sea and the harbour far below, a clear morning, no people visible inside, no logos.
images.alt: A cable car cabin climbing over the slopes above Funchal towards Monte

images.prompt: Inside an old Madeira wine lodge in Funchal: dark wooden casks stacked on their sides in a dim cellar with old beams and a little warm light from a window, a few small tasting glasses of amber wine on a cask top in the foreground, no people, no readable labels.
images.alt: Wooden casks and tasting glasses inside an old wine lodge in Funchal
